title: nan
authors: Crocoll P.; Caselitz T.; Hettich B.; Langer M.; Trommer G.F.
key_contribution: Presents a laser-aided Kalman filter navigation system with loop closure detection and pose graph optimization for Micro Aerial Vehicles in indoor and urban GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
